description: This file defines the ApplicationClientFactory interface in the org.eclipse.hono.client package, which provides factory methods for creating various clients related to Hono's northbound APIs, including telemetry, event, command response consumers, and command clients.

classes.name: ApplicationClientFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating clients for various Hono northbound APIs, including telemetry, events, commands, and command responses, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, as well as connection lifecycle management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ApplicationClientFactory instance associated with the provided HonoConnection.

methods.name: createTelemetryConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer client for receiving telemetry data from Hono's Telemetry API.

methods.name: createEventConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer client for receiving events from Hono's Event API (with support for automatic message settlement).

methods.name: createEventConsumer
methods.description: Overloaded method to create a consumer client for receiving events with custom settlement handling.

methods.name: createAsyncCommandResponseConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for asynchronous command response messages, for command responses to be received separately.

methods.name: createAsyncCommandResponseConsumer
methods.description: Overloaded method supporting a BiConsumer for handling command responses with delivery context.

methods.name: getOrCreateCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a command client for sending commands to devices of a specified tenant.

methods.name: getOrCreateCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a command client with a specified replyId, ensuring unique reply-to addresses.

methods.name: getOrCreateAsyncCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an asynchronous command client for the specified tenant, for receiving command responses asynchronously.
